release_read.basis: The short thesis (Q3 miss on licensing, guide cut, dividend at risk) is contradicted: revenue $20.7m vs ~$20.3m, licensing $11.7m (+35%) vs ~$11m implied, EPS $0.08 vs $0.03, FY guide's low end raised to $79-82m revenue / $20-22m adj. key_line.detail: Licensing $11.7m (+35% y/y) met/beat the ~$11m the bar needed despite only $1.9m of RPO at Q2; FY revenue guide narrowed up from $77-82m to $79-82m, adj. EBITDA from $18-22m to $20-22m. Weak spots: gross margin 48.8% vs 58.7% on AI revenue share, 9M operating cash flow $1.5m vs $9.1m, cash+investments $10.0m (cash $5.5m) against a $17-22m year-end guide.

guidance.detail: FY2026 revenue $79-82m (was $77-82m, 2026-08-12), adj. EBITDA $20-22m (was $18-22m); street FY revenue sat at $78.75-79.25m, so the new low end is at/above consensus. Dividend $0.085 maintained.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions, call coverage or retail threads found this morning; only the release itself and pre-print previews surfaced. Three covering analysts were all Buy (targets $5-6) before the print.

tape_read.note: Robust reference $2.798 = +18.1% vs prev close $2.37 (after-hours +15.3%, pre-market range $2.67-2.85), active (147 prints, 22 in the last 30 min, last print 09:13, not stale). That is inside the 23.3% implied move but about 6 points above my frozen +12% release read, which discounts the margin drop and the weak cash position; the market is down (SPY -0.7%, QQQ -1.4%, IWM -0.4%). The short is -19.1% vs the 13:30 entry.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a licensing miss against an unrevised $20.3m bar and a guide cut; licensing came in at $11.7m, revenue beat and the guide's low end was raised, dividend kept. Only the cash/margin strand of the thesis survives.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is active and recent, so the open should hold most of the +18% move; an 18% gap in a sub-$3 microcap that sits above what the release supports (margin and cash weakness, Q2's +42.5% pop faded fully within two weeks) tends to give part back in the first half hour, in a weak tape. No call or news lands before 10:00.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers spreken de short-these tegen (omzet en licenties boven verwachting, jaarprognose omhoog, dividend behouden), dus deze positie moet vandaag dicht. De koers staat voorbeurs ruim 18% hoger, meer dan de cijfers rechtvaardigen gezien de lagere brutomarge en de dunne kaspositie; zo'n grote sprong zakt in het eerste half uur vaak wat terug, dus dekken om 10:00 in plaats van bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 verder oploopt boven $2,85 (de voorbeurshoogste) of er een koersdoelverhoging of positief verslag van de call verschijnt, dan direct bij de opening dekken.
